newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Leisure Management in racing club deal.
newsitem.headline: Leisure Management in racing club deal.

text.p: Malaysia's Leisure Management Bhd said it has agreed to buy 34 percent of Philippine Racing Club Inc from Philippine Realty & Holdings Corp for 198.3 million ringgit in cash.
In a statement issued late on Wednesday, Leisure said the purchase involves 165.24 million shares of Philippine Racing Club Inc for about 1.20 ringgit a share.

The Philippine firm is one of two holders of a Philippines franchise to own and operate a horse racing club, including a nationwide off-track betting system. Its franchise was recently extended for 25 years.
Sixto Sandejas, corporate secretary of the Philippine firm, said in a statement on Wednesday the sale is scheduled to take place on October 16.
He said the sale agreement is also conditional on devising a mutually acceptable management role for the Malaysian firm.
Leisure Management which is already in the gaming business in Malaysia through the sale of betting tickets, said the purchase would be financed by borrowings and internally generated funds.
It said it intends to refinance the proposed acquisition in the longer term through debt, equity or a combination of the two.
"The proposed acquisition will enable LM to widen its core business by diversifying into the Philippines racing and betting business," Leisure Management said in the statement.
Leisure's stock, which had been suspended for a news announcement, was requoted on Thursday. The shares gained 65 cents to nine ringgit in morning trading.
